acceptance_evidence.evidence: server.rs declares the bounded MAX_PRESENCE_COMMANDS capacity as 32, preserves FIFO lifecycle records with nonblocking try_send, and turns TrySendError::Full into the shared PresenceQueueFull fatal signal. The presence_lane_retains_capacity_and_never_strands_shutdown and presence_lane_overflow_is_a_stable_fatal_signal tests passed; no Full branch silently succeeds.

server.rs sets lifecycle_forwarding_disabled before SESSION_READY/reset rearm and handle_presence_command rejects queued or later lifecycle records without allocating a sidecar sequence. reboot_reset_fences_queued_presence_for_the_local_session passed and proves no lifecycle frame follows reset.

The fieldless RomPresenceReset remains the canonical event; complete_reboot_rearm sends SESSION_READY first and retains rearm_after_reboot on an ambiguous reset write, while resume_checkpoint_handoff retries it only under the documented launcher-fatal/no-restart invariant. fieldless_reset_retry_requires_launcher_fatal_no_restart_policy passed, without claiming exactly-once delivery.

control.rs has strict canonical round-trip, unknown-field, invalid-field, and LF-inclusive <=512-byte coverage for all six presence records, including a custom strict empty-object reset decoder. server.rs covers malformed exact 28/20-byte inbound payloads with no sequence commit, exact 72/40/16-byte outbound payloads with independent outer sequences, and quiescing no-allocation behavior; all passed.

The focused and full coop-sidecar tests passed (88 total), strict Clippy with -D warnings passed, cargo fmt --check passed, and git diff --check passed. Launcher compilation is intentionally not duplicated: it is a root-owned aggregate/cross-unit check and is outside this worker's two-file ownership and fixer verification manifest; this is reported rather than represented as a worker pass.
